about: What of the Publisher's receipts may be public in rnd-data. Deny by default for content: a file is public only when a public rule names it, it carries no content marker, and the identity scan passed it. Rules are checked in order: identity (from the reasons file), then private, then content markers, then public; anything left is private as 'unapproved'. Agreed with the Publisher on 2026-10-19 after their P3 review; either side changes it only by agreement. Patterns: 'name' matches the file name, 'path' the path under receipts/ (fnmatch; * crosses folders).
